info.title: Ashicore Agent Production Planning API
info.description: Read-only production-planning context for external AI assistants. The ERP remains authoritative for planning calculations; this API returns the current board state and planning facts for reasoning.

get.description: Returns all open sales orders, manufacturing orders, purchase orders, relevant inventory, active allocations, and the ERP planning snapshot. This endpoint is read-only and does not create manufacturing orders, purchase orders, allocations, or inventory events.

parameters.name: includePlanningFacts
parameters.description: When false, omits large planning fact arrays. Defaults to true for full-context reasoning.

parameters.name: includeLots
parameters.description: When false, returns inventory items without lot detail. Defaults to true.

401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked, or expired agent API token.

403.description: The token does not have production-planning read scope.

agentBearerAuth.description: Use an Ashicore agent API token generated from the ERP. In ChatGPT Actions, configure authentication as API Key or Bearer token so requests send Authorization: Bearer <token>.

inputHash.description: Stable hash for the planning inputs. Future write workflows should compare against this before acting.

items.description: Inventory context. availableQty is current usable on-hand after reservations; projectedQty is planning-derived future net quantity. Inventory-lot allocations and manufacturing-output allocations are split into separate fields.

planning.description: ERP planning snapshot, including horizon, assumptions, rows, facts, recommendations, blockers, paths, warnings, and inputHash.
